input_schema.input_paths: Must include the architecture, requirements, Narrative, and Tech Stack.

design_plan_path.description: Path of the Design Plan document, when this round produced or revised it; omit otherwise. Also listed in `paths` like every other file you wrote — naming it here as well is what lets the engine tell the Plan apart from the Functional Designs when it hands them to later stages.

designs.description: Which Functional Design you wrote for which component: {"LEADERBOARD": "billing-service/specs/design/LEADERBOARD.md"}. Every design in `paths` should appear here. You write them per component, so you already know this — declaring it is what lets a later stage be handed one component's design rather than all of them.

component_order.description: The Design Plan's component order (codenames in batch order). Set when this round produced the Design Plan; omit otherwise.
